summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests BL-B01D1 in adults with metastatic or unresectable non-small cell lung cancer and other solid tumors. BL-B01D1 is given by intravenous infusion every 3 weeks, on Day 1 or on Day 1 and Day 8, and the total length of treatment is not stated. The stated objective is to evaluate safety, tolerability, and efficacy, and the specific main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa BL-B01D1 en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas metastásico o no resecable y otros tumores sólidos. BL-B01D1 se administra por infusión intravenosa cada 3 semanas, el Día 1 o el Día 1 y el Día 8, y la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. El objetivo declarado es evaluar la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la eficacia, y la medida de resultado principal específica no se indica.
who_for: Age 18 years or older with a life expectancy of at least 3 months.
Incurable, locally advanced or metastatic cancer of the listed types, with disease progression after prior treatment.
At least one measurable lesion according to RECIST v1.1.
Adequate blood counts, liver, kidney and clotting function, and no serious heart dysfunction.
not_for: Symptomatic heart failure, prior heart attack, unstable angina, or prolonged QT interval.
History of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or grade 3 lung disease.
Active autoimmune or inflammatory disease requiring systemic treatment.
Other malignant tumors diagnosed within 5 years, with some skin cancer exceptions.
Active or untreated brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
